notes: Account summary: large payments + claims platform that also stores limited PHI fields on some transactions. Must run inference inside a customer-managed VPC or approved on-prem cluster; cannot tolerate model-hosted exposure. Primary asks: agent-assist that can call internal tools (ticket updates, escalation), fast ticket summarization for CSR handoffs, and reliable handling of correlation/throughput spikes during outage windows. Latency target: agent-facing prompts <= 300ms 95th pct under normal load; degrade to sub-second with graceful fallback during peaks. Throughput target: sustain 1,200 concurrent agent sessions with burst capacity to 3x for incidents. Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to pay for predictable reserved capacity but need unit-cost optimization (Optimize recommendations, quantized model profiles). Model preferences: customer-preferred quantized open models with offline verification; fallback to smaller distilled variant for throughput spikes. Routing/fallback: prefer smart routing by policy (region + tier) with automatic fallback to dedicated local variant; must support deterministic eviction and KV cache persistence across agent sessions. Security/compliance notes: "Will require SSO (SAML/Okta), strict audit logs for all model calls, tokenized PHI retention rules (90-day retention for transcripts, 7 years for payment audit logs where required), and HSM-backed key management. PCI DSS scoping: Redwood artifacts must be segmented; need architecture diagram showing network flow and ingress/egress. Legal & procurement: DPA + PCI addendum + SOC2 attestations requested. POC scope: 3-week, staged: 1) basic agent-assist smoke in VPC (week 1), 2) tool-calling + ticket summarization with synthetic calls (week 2), 3) spike/failover testing + audit log export validation (week 3). "Customer quotes: 'We can't have PHI leave our VPC' — Director of Support. 'Need clear failover that doesn't increase risk during payment spikes' — Head of Ops. Next actions: send VPC network diagram template, confirm HSM vendor list, draft procurement SOW. Quick wins: demo of ticket-summarization workflow + examples for legal review.
